candidates.title: Is the Alberta government engaging in American-style gerrymandering?

candidates.title: Landslide prompts evacuation order for Zeballos on Vancouver Island
candidates.description: A state of local emergency and an evacuation order have been issued for Zeballos, a village of about 125 people on the northwest coast of Vancouver Island, due to flooding and landslide risks.

candidates.title: Man convicted in deadly 2018 Toronto van attack drops appeal
candidates.description: The man who carried out a deadly van attack in Toronto eight years ago is no longer challenging his more than two dozen convictions.

candidates.title: Council seat in Norfolk County, Ont., finally decided by a draw out of a top hat
candidates.description: After a long campaign, a recount and two weeks of uncertainty, the race for a Norfolk County council seat was left up to fate. Chris Van Paassen will return as Ward 4 councillor after Norfolk County Clerk William Tigert drew his name from a hat Thursday night, breaking a tie with challenger Jeni Lambert.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Windsor residents not ready to return to U.S. despite Democratic midterm wins
candidates.description: Despite renewed optimism about the future of Canada-U.S. relations, some residents say they need to see meaningful changes in Washington before they'll feel comfortable spending their money across the border.

candidates.title: A mysterious U.S. army barrel washed ashore in Quebec. Why did it drum up anthrax concerns?

candidates.title: They thought they buried their brother in the family plot; it was a stranger instead
candidates.description: When two sisters from Springdale, N.L., made arrangements to bury their brother, they weren’t prepared for the ordeal ahead. Now, a year later, they’re hoping by sharing their story, it will lead to changes in how cremations are handled in the province.

candidates.title: First Nation sounds alarm over Ontario proposal to prevent 'obstruction' to development
candidates.description: The Ontario government is considering changes to address what it calls “obstruction” to economic development projects, raising concerns from Neskantaga First Nation about its right to defend its homelands. candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Saskatoon mother sentenced for baby's drowning death in bathtub

candidates.title: Court action halted after clergy therapy centre reveals destruction of records related to abusive priest

candidates.title: Polish defence minister calls Krakow shooting an 'act of terror' after 6 killed, 16 injured

candidates.title: The age of AI warfare has dawned. Is Canada ready?

candidates.title: Canada's military is using Palantir software. What are the risks?

candidates.title: Why the U.S. midterm results may show 'money stops mattering'

candidates.description: The faculty senate of Cornell University approved a resolution Friday declaring no confidence in the school's top leaders, a symbolic gesture reflecting deep discontent on campus in the wake of a former student's lawsuit saying she was gang raped at a fraternity party in 2024.

candidates.title: U.S. sanctions Canadian money-exchange businesses allegedly connected to Iranian regime, Ryan Wedding

Democrats, who were traditionally the party of protectionism, appear to have been pushed into a more pro-free trade stance, and appear ready to try to reach a deal with Republicans.

candidates.description: * WHAT...West winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and waves 5 to 8 ft expected. * WHERE...Ontonagon to Upper Entrance of Portage Canal MI and Upper Entrance of Portage Canal to Eagle River MI. * WHEN...From 10 PM this evening to 10 PM EST Sunday. * IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

candidates.title: Small Craft Advisory issued November 7 at 3:06PM EST until November 8 at 7:00AM EST by NWS Marquette MI
candidates.description: * WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, west winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and waves 1 to 3 ft expected. For the Gale Warning, northwest winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 45 kt and waves 10 to 15 ft expected. * WHERE...Marquette to Munising MI and Munising to Grand Marais MI. * WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, from 4 AM to 7 AM EST Sunday. For the Gale Warning, from 7 AM to 10 PM EST Sunday. * IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous waves which could capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
